sources.organization: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism (Travison TG et al.)
sources.title: Harmonized Reference Ranges for Circulating Testosterone Levels in Men of Four Cohort Studies in the United States and Europe
sources.quote: In healthy nonobese men, 19 to 39 years, harmonized 2.5th, 5th, 50th, 95th, and 97.5th percentile values were 264, 303, 531, 852, and 916 ng/dL, respectively.

sources.title: Landmark study defines normal ranges for testosterone levels
sources.quote: The harmonized normal range for testosterone in a non-obese population of European and American Men, 19-39 years, is 264-916 ng/dL.

sources.organization: Endocrine Reviews (Swerdloff RS, Dudley RE, Page ST, Wang C, Salameh WA)
sources.title: Dihydrotestosterone: Biochemistry, Physiology, and Clinical Implications of Elevated Blood Levels
sources.quote: A DHT reference range of 14 to 77 ng/dL (0.47 to 2.65 nmol/L) for healthy adult men (18 to 59 years; n = 113) has been reported by Shiraishi et al.
